blocks.text: Surrey houses by price band, October 2026

113 houses sold in October against 1,033 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 38 sold (34% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $900,001 to $1,000,000 at 27%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Surrey?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 1,033 houses listed in Surrey and 113 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Surrey?
faq.a: The October report gave $1,248,000 for houses in Surrey, against $1,215,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Surrey?
faq.a: The October report showed 44 days on market for houses in Surrey and a sale-to-list price ratio of 96%, against 28 days the month before.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Surrey?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Surrey?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
